bootstrap.method: Hold50 tasks fixed/equally weighted; resample10 source IDs within each task with replacement; identical draw reused across all cells/differences. Same task/source sort and draw as H10 analysis.
bootstrap.confidence_interval: Pointwise percentile2.5/97.5%; not multiplicity-adjusted. No new hypothesis tests.
bootstrap.scope_limit: Conditional on fixed50tasks and empirical10sources/task; excludes task-population and model-training-seed uncertainty.

training_coverage_strata.basis: Pre-existing5task training coverage supplied by parent; fixed descriptive strata only, no new confidence intervals/tests or selection.

interpretation_limits: H30-vs-H10 comparisons are descriptive cross-H paired results, not equivalence tests.
Saved policy call totals are realized trajectory costs, affected by early success/termination; no total inference-time, GPU-time or speedup claim.
No incompleteH results, implementations, model/device queries, hashes, experiments or strict audits were read/run.
N lacks explicit sampling_calls/interventions in episode rows; report saved policy_calls separately, do not invent absent counters.
